title: Nibbidā
text: 2. Cattāro me bhikkhave iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abbhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti || katame cattāro || || 3. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipadaṃ bhāveti ||viriyasamādhi || cittasamādhi || vīmaṃsasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || || 4. Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantī ti || ||
